explication: Paperless-ngx is a document management system that turns scanned or uploaded files into a searchable archive. The principal workflow is: a user uploads or consumes a document; backend processing parses and OCRs it; metadata and classification are applied; the document and derived text are stored and indexed; the user searches, reviews, edits, shares, or automates it. The tree also shows mail ingestion, workflows, AI indexing/chat, administration, versioning, and permissions. Some backend call paths are inferred from explicit module responsibilities and signal registrations; unsampled implementations are represented conservatively.
